description: This file defines a React component 'TagContextMenu' that provides a contextual menu for tag-related actions such as favoriting, renaming, deleting, and adding subtags. It manages user interactions, state, and UI elements specific to tag management within a tagging system.

methods.name: onClickAddSubtag
methods.description: Handles the click event to add a subtag; activates premium modal if user is not entitled.

methods.name: onClickRename
methods.description: Handles the click event to initiate renaming of the selected tag.

methods.name: onClickDelete
methods.description: Handles the click event to delete the selected tag.

methods.name: handleIconChange
methods.description: Updates the icon associated with the selected tag when changed.

methods.name: onClickStar
methods.description: Toggles the starred (favorite) status of the tag.
